name: Blackened Cajun Catfish Fillet (Carbon Char WARNING)
whyItWorks: Dredged in heavy cayenne pepper, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder, then pan-seared in butter at extreme heat until a blackened carbon crust forms. Capsaicin and bitter char irritate tender gastrointestinal mucosa and trigger urgent spasms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid blackened fish. Ask for fresh fish to be simply broiled with olive oil, salt, and oregano.
